definitions.explanation: Something that could not be predicted. Used almost only before a noun with の, above all in the phrase for an unforeseen situation or emergency.

examples.japanese: {不測|ふそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
{不測|ふそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。

⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不測|ふそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧べきだ。
examples.english: When climbing a mountain, you should take more food than planned in case of the unexpected.

notes:
Formal: news, official notices, business.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不測|ふそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧: an unforeseen situation, an emergency
- {不測|ふそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: an unforeseen accident
- {不測|ふそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧: unforeseen damage

WATCH OUT:
⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧ (shortage) is read the same. {不測|ふそく} comes from ⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (to measure): "cannot be measured in advance."
